data.notes: Confirmed April listings are relatively sparse, with the strongest anchors being Semana Santa choral programming, a local urban/champeta concert, and a mid-month afro-house DJ night.

events.title: XVI Festival de Coros y Música Sacra
events.summary: Semana Santa choral and sacred-music program running 6:00–8:00 p.m. at Plaza de Variedades, Chambacú, as part of Cartagena’s official cultural agenda. The event centers on free presentations by choirs and sacred-music ensembles.

events.title: Luister La Voz at Prestige Club Alta Gama
events.summary: Cartagenaplay lists a live performance by Luister La Voz at Prestige Club Alta Gama, with DJs Bryan Rodríguez, Luham24, and Luis Borja also billed. The event is presented as a ticketed “SuperConcierto” in Cartagena.

events.title: Moojo Cartagena
events.summary: French DJ/producer Moojo headlines an intimate Los Calvitos Events night at Museo Naval del Caribe. Resident Advisor lists the event with house and afro-house genres and an 8:00 p.m.–3:00 a.m. schedule.

events.title: DJ Stailin at Green Moon Bar Disco
events.summary: Shazam/Bandsintown lists DJ Stailin for a confirmed April 30 appearance at Green Moon Bar Disco in Cartagena. The listing connects the show to the artist’s 2026 tour schedule and recent amapiano/urban releases.
